attributes.board_name: Connecticut Department of Public Health, Practitioner Licensing and Investigations Section (Board of Examiners for Physical Therapists)

rules.accepted_credit_types: CE in areas related to the individual's practice, including but not limited to courses offered or approved by APTA or any APTA component, a hospital or other licensed health care institution, or a regionally accredited institution of higher education. Internet-based and distance learning accepted if related to PT practice. DPH does not approve or pre-approve courses.
rules.new_licensee_rule: CE waived for the first license renewal.
rules.carryover: Not allowed: hours from one registration period cannot carry over.
rules.audit_note: Keep certificates of completion 3 years after the renewal date they apply to; submit within 45 days of a DPH request. Waiver/extension possible for medical disability or illness (notarized application with medical certification).

topics.who: Screening for PTSD, risk of suicide, depression and grief, and suicide prevention: in the first registration period CE is required, then at least once every 6 years; the state youth suicide prevention program (§17a-52a) can satisfy the suicide prevention part
Ethics and jurisprudence, on and after January 1, 2026: in the first registration period CE is required, then at least once every 2 years (P.A. 25-97)

rules.legal_basis: Conn. Gen. Stat. §20-73b (as amended by P.A. 25-97)
rules.notes: Annual license renewal (registration period = the 12 months for which the license is renewed under §19a-88); 20 hours in each registration period. The ethics/jurisprudence hours were added effective July 1, 2025 for CE on and after January 1, 2026; the DPH CE page does not yet mention them.
rules.rule_quote: …each physical therapist licensed pursuant to this chapter shall complete a minimum of twenty hours of continuing education during each registration period. For purposes of this section, registration period means the twelve-month period for which a license has been renewed in accordance with section 19a-88 and is current and valid.

rules.notes: The CE statute (§20-73b) applies to licensed physical therapists; DPH's list of license types with continuing education requirements includes Physical Therapist only, not Physical Therapist Assistant.
